title: Tilapia-derived oligopeptide LSGYG inhibits tumor metastasis via electrostatic-lock-like retention at the catalytic region of MMP-2 and suppression of the HIF-1alpha-mediated EMT-like cascade.
authors: Chen, Yizhu; Huang, Huixue; Liu, Yi; Qian, Zhong-Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究罗非鱼寡肽LSGYG与MMP-2蛋白的分子互作及抗肿瘤转移机制，虽涉及蛋白-肽结合模拟，但对象为酶-肽而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法上虽有计算模拟但非AI或MD聚焦TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Numerous studies have reported the biological activities of tilapia skin oligopeptides, which exhibit diverse physiological effects. However, research on the relationship between peptide structural characteristics and their activities remains relatively scarce. In this study, we combined computational simulations with biological experiments to investigate the anti-metastatic mechanism of the tilapia skin oligopeptide LSGYG. Computational analyses supported recurrent Zn-neighboring and pocket-associated recognition modes of LSGYG in the catalytic region of matrix metalloproteinase-2 (MMP-2) and identified a dynamically retained pocket-stabilized state with near-Zn anchoring features. Pulling-guided umbrella-window screening further provided qualitative support for a local metastable region near the Zn-adjacent catalytic microenvironment. Subsequent in vitro evaluations demonstrated that LSGYG significantly suppressed migration and invasion in phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA)-induced HT1080 cells and reduced metastasis-related molecular signaling in both HT1080 and 143B cells. Mechanistically, LSGYG substantially disrupted extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-like changes by downregulating MMP-2, MMP-9, N-cadherin, Vimentin, and the upstream regulator hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha), while restoring E-cadherin expression. These phenotypic reversals were associated with suppression of reactive oxygen species (ROS), mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK), phosphoinositide 3-kinase/protein kinase B (PI3K/AKT), and nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathways. These findings support LSGYG as a tilapia-derived bioactive peptide candidate for anti-metastatic functional-food or nutraceutical development.
abstract_zh: 大量研究报道了罗非鱼皮寡肽的生物活性，其表现出多种生理效应。然而，关于肽结构特征与其活性之间关系的研究仍相对匮乏。在本研究中，我们结合计算模拟与生物学实验，探讨了罗非鱼皮寡肽LSGYG的抗转移机制。计算分析支持LSGYG在基质金属蛋白酶-2（MMP-2）催化区域中反复出现的Zn邻近和口袋相关识别模式，并识别出一种动态保留的口袋稳定状态，具有近Zn锚定特征。拉动引导的伞形窗口筛选进一步为Zn邻近催化微环境附近的局部亚稳定区域提供了定性支持。随后的体外评估表明，LSGYG显著抑制了佛波醇-12-肉豆蔻酸酯-13-乙酸酯（PMA）诱导的HT1080细胞中的迁移和侵袭，并降低了HT1080和143B细胞中与转移相关的分子信号传导。机制上，LSGYG通过下调MMP-2、MMP-9、N-钙黏蛋白、波形蛋白及上游调控因子缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α），同时恢复E-钙黏蛋白表达，显著破坏了细胞外基质（ECM）重塑和上皮-间质转化（EMT）样变化。这些表型逆转与活性氧（ROS）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）、磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B（PI3K/AKT）和核因子κB（NF-κB）信号通路的抑制相关。这些发现支持LSGYG作为罗非鱼来源的生物活性肽候选物，可用于抗转移功能性食品或营养保健品的开发。
